summary: A Bexley North agency led by Julie and Nikko appears to lose seller and landlord enquiries because the homepage offers only an email and a phone number to reach them.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to have no enquiry form, only an email address and a phone number.
findings.cost: A seller who is only browsing will not stop to write an email or make a call, so a hot lead can leave without a trace.
findings.fix: A short enquiry form on the homepage that sends you the lead at once.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp or text option appears on the page.
findings.cost: Property owners message first and call later, and the agent who replies fastest wins the listing.
findings.fix: A one tap WhatsApp and text button.

findings.problem: Several listings appear to show Contact Agent instead of a price or detail.
findings.cost: A buyer who cannot see a price often moves on to the next listing.
findings.fix: Clearer listing cards with a next step.

redesign: Homepage form that captures every seller.
Listing cards that move buyers to call.
